headline: Markets Today: Euro Zone output rebounds, gold and silver extend slide, FTSE 100 resilient
summary: Gold and silver extended losses while tech stocks fell, as the nomination of Warsh boosted the dollar. Euro zone output rebounded and the FTSE 100 remained resilient.
why: Gold and silver are traditional stores of value that often move against the US dollar and real interest-rate expectations.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Gold extended its slide as the dollar strengthened after the Warsh nomination.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

impacts.name: Silver
impacts.why: Silver extended its slide alongside gold.
